_comment: Target Assassin or Mystic attack action card gets +2{p}; if you've transcended this turn, INSTEAD +4{p}. Modeled as a base +2 plus a second +2 gated on the TRANSCENDED flag (so +2 normally, +4 when transcended). Prior JSON gated the WHOLE ability on TRANSCENDED (giving nothing when not transcended) and used an unrecognized 'additional_effects' key.
